title: Nourishing Dense Argentinian White Fish Fillets Casserole
description: A winey and dense Argentinian dish featuring white fish fillets, perfect for meal prep. This nut-free-friendly casserole is a great option for a healthy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the white wine to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the wine simmer for 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onion and garlic mixture, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Add the white fish fillets to the bowl and toss to coat with the onion mixture.
In a large casserole dish, arrange the fish fillets in a single layer.
Top the fish with the cherry tomatoes and pour the remaining wine sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
